name: inverse_benchmark_details
description:
Inverse Problem Benchmark (Paper2Executable)
	

A comprehensive benchmark of 200 inverse problem tasks spanning computational imaging, spectroscopy, medical imaging, astrophysics, geophysics, and more.

	
		
		Overview
	

This repository contains standardized implementations of inverse problems from scientific computing papers. Each task includes:

Source code (src/) - Complete implementation
Test scripts (test_*.py) - Automated testing
Data (data/) - Input data, ground truth outputs… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/csusupergear/inverse_benchmark_details.
evaluation_method: task-dependent reconstruction/error metrics (MSE/RMSE, PSNR, SSIM, etc.)
typical_sota_score: varies widely across tasks; no single SOTA
reputation: A comprehensive repository of executable inverse-problem tasks used by researchers in scientific computing; valued for standardization but not a single unified leaderboard.
